caption: The drawing features a wooden table with a polished brown finish, depicted in the center of the composition. The table has four curved cabriole legs and a scalloped apron. It features three drawers on the front side, each with a metallic handle, appearing gold or brass in color. Around the main drawing, there are three additional detailed line drawings: in the upper right corner is a sketch of the drawer handle at actual size, showing its ornate design; in the upper left corner is an outlined drawing of one of the table legs, emphasizing its curvature and proportions; in the bottom left corner is a cross-section drawing of a rectangular structural element of the table. The main table is rendered in color while the supplementary details are in black line on a light background. The artist’s name, A. Walbeck, is written in the lower right corner. The drawing includes some scale notations for reference.
title: Lowboy
